notes: All geometry is the VOYAGER BLACK colourway: oneplus.com publishes per-colourway thicknesses and weights (closed 11.7 mm / open 5.8 mm / 245 g for Emerald Dusk; closed 11.9 mm / open 5.9 mm / 239 g for Voyager Black AND Crimson Shadow). Height and width are identical across colourways. Fetched from the global/US page www.oneplus.com/us/open/specs; www.oneplus.com/global/open/specs carries the same mm values (it omits Crimson Shadow), and the India page (redirects to oneplus.in) states the same numbers in cm. No unit conversion was performed - OnePlus states mm directly. refresh_hz records the MAXIMUM of the OEM's dynamic range: cover 'Refresh Rate: 10-120 Hz dynamic', inner 'Refresh Rate: 1-120 Hz dynamic'. panel normalised to OLED; OEM wording is 'Super Fluid AMOLED with LTPO 3.0' (cover) and 'Flexi-fluid AMOLED with LTPO 3.0' (inner). resolution_px is recorded exactly as OnePlus prints it ('2484*1116' cover, '2440*2268' inner); OnePlus does not label which figure is width and which is height, and for the portrait cover screen the first number is clearly the long axis - i.e. the ordering is NOT the [width,height] order Google uses, so consumers must not assume a common order across the entries in this array. Cover aspect is printed by OnePlus as '20:09'; recorded here as 20:9. hinge.crease=teardrop rests on OnePlus's own press-release wording about the 'water-drop'-shaped hinge that minimises the crease (the product page words it as 'The “waterdrop”-shaped tension relief mechanism ensures a larger bend radius, minimizing the display crease'); OnePlus never uses the words 'teardrop' or 'U-shaped'. hinge.free_stop left null: no OnePlus page fetched (specs, overview, press release) documents free-stop or hold-at-any-angle. materials.frame left NULL: OnePlus publishes only 'Key hinge components utilize a proprietary cobalt molybdenum alloy' and the marketing line 'Titanium alloy, carbon fiber, and more' - neither states the frame/mid-frame material for this model. released left null: the OnePlus press release dates the launch 2023-10-19 but no OnePlus page states the on-sale date. hinge.type/axis are the registry's family assignment, corroborated by OnePlus's own opened/closed figures - width 73.3 mm -> 143.1 mm at a constant 153.4 mm height, i.e. a book fold about the long axis. active_area_mm left null: deriving it from a marketing diagonal with rounded corners would invent precision.
